name: Tamil Pudhalvan Scheme
provider: Social Welfare & Women Empowerment Department, Government of Tamil Nadu

rules.quote: All boy students who studied from Classes 6 to 12 in Government schools and Government aided schools in tamil medium will be paid Rs.1,000/- per month

rules.value: Studied classes 6-12 in Government or Government-aided (Tamil medium) schools
rules.quote: paid on a monthly basis to all eligible boy students who have studied from 6th 12th Std. in Government schools and Government aided schools in tamil medium.
till the uninterrupted completion of their undergraduate degree, diploma and ITI courses

rules.value: Only first course of higher education; other scholarships allowed concurrently
rules.quote: The boy students availing other scholarships are also eligible to enroll in this scheme.

amount.text: Rs 1,000 per month via DBT till completion of first higher-education course
amount.quote: Cash incentive of Rs.1000/month per beneficiary as DBT will be sanctioned till the competition of their first higher education.

deadline.text: Rolling; apply on the UMIS portal
deadline.quote: This scheme activity is implemented through online portal 'UMIS' wherein the boy students themselves can apply for the scheme directly.
